notes: Access: HTTP tier 1 only, via the site's own unauthenticated Magento GraphQL endpoint (https://www.swooneditions.com/graphql), same route as the prior Home-Decor pass (notes/49.md). Enumerated the full category tree with `{categories(pageSize:400,currentPage:N,filters:{})}` across 3 pages (1120 nodes total) and keyword-scanned name fields for best*/popular/favourite/trending/top/must/editor/pick terms. Found one genuine Bestsellers section, id 320, url_path 'bestsellers', meta_title 'Swoon Bestsellers | Popular Furniture | Swoon', description 'Satisfy your home obsession and shop our range of best seller designs' - confirmed genuine merchandising PLP, not editorial. It has 9 real nav children (children_count=9, all found): a type-cut (Tables, Accessories, Storage, Seating, Beds, Desks) and a room-cut (Living Room, Bedroom, Dining Room) both nested directly under the same Bestsellers parent - both are genuine site nav nodes (same dual-taxonomy pattern the prior Furniture/Lighting pass documented for this store), so both are kept; the type-cut and room-cut subsets overlap each other (children sum ~1498 vs parent total_count 980), which is expected overlap between two facets of the same product pool, not an error. For every row, product_count (category field) and products(filter:{category_id}).total_count (live products query) were compared and matched exactly on all 10 nodes tested; total_count was additionally exhaustively verified against the raw items array for the New In id=140 node from the sibling New-Arrivals extraction (34 total_count == 34 items returned) to confirm this store's total_count is not inflated, consistent with the prior pass's finding for this same site. ALSO CHECKED AND EXCLUDED: 'Bestseller edit' (category id 1624, url flash-sale/bestseller-edit, product_count 20) - this sits under the 'Flash SALE' promotional section, not under the genuine Bestsellers node; its meta_title/description ('50% off Best Sellers... this is a sale you don't want to miss... doesn't linger') is Flash-Sale marketing copy reusing the word 'Bestseller' as a discount theme, not the site's own Bestsellers merchandising concept - excluded per the PDP/marketing-badge exclusion rule (a page merely mentioning bestselling products in a sale context is not itself a Bestsellers PLP). No other best*/popular/trending nodes found anywhere in the 1120-node tree.
